sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which is the correct adjective of comparison to fill in the blank? Mount Everest is the ___ mountain peak in the world.
Choose the correct preposition: The frightened little puppy hid ___ the large dining table during the loud thunderstorm.
In the game of Lagori, what item do the players use to hit and knock down the tower?
Select the correct conjunction: I wanted to play outside in the garden, ___ it started raining heavily.
Which adverb correctly completes the sentence? The old green tortoise walked very ___ towards the finish line.
According to the poem 'The Swing', how does going up in the air make the young child feel?
Identify the correct past tense verb: She ___ to the local market yesterday evening to buy fresh vegetables.
What does the common English idiom 'piece of cake' mean?
options: D) A loud and sudden noise

questions.question_text: In the chapter 'A Journey to the Magical Mountains', what kind of natural scenery would you mostly find?
options: C) Snowy peaks and green valleys
questions.answer: C) Snowy peaks and green valleys

questions.question_text: The beautiful historic town of Maheshwar is located on the banks of which famous Indian river?

sections.section_name: Section B - Short Answer and Grammar Competency

questions.question_text: Why is it highly important to play outdoor sports regularly according to the chapter 'Fit Body Fit Mind Fit Nation'? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Playing outdoor sports helps us build strong muscles, keeps our mind active and fresh, and teaches us how to work together as a healthy team.

questions.question_text: Rewrite this sentence correctly in the simple future tense: 'The little boy plays happily in the school park.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The little boy will play happily in the school park. He will have a great time running around and enjoying the fresh air with friends.

questions.question_text: Briefly explain how a playing team actually wins a round in the traditional game of Lagori. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A team wins by carefully stacking all seven flat stones back in order after they are knocked down, while avoiding being hit by the ball.

questions.question_text: Join these two separate sentences into one complete sentence using the conjunction 'because': 'I was late for school. I missed the morning bus.' [20-30 words]
questions.answer: I was late for school because I missed the morning bus. Therefore, I had to walk quickly so that I would not miss the assembly.

questions.question_text: Describe the main character Hekko's unique and special ability from your literature reader. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hekko is a very clever bird who can perfectly mimic the different sounds of humans, animals, and vehicles that he hears around him every day.

questions.question_text: Read the sentence: 'The brave little dog fiercely barked at the stranger.' Identify one adjective and one adverb, and explain how they describe this situation. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The adjective 'brave' describes the little dog's fearless nature when facing someone new. The adverb 'fiercely' describes exactly how the dog was barking, showing that it was very loud and aggressive in order to protect its house from the unknown stranger.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are swinging high up in the air like the child in the poem 'The Swing'. Describe what beautiful scenery you can see. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: As I swing high up into the bright blue sky, I can see far across the green countryside. I spot the winding blue river, tall leafy trees, grazing cattle, and the brown roofs of village houses stretching into the far distance.

sections.section_name: Section D - Expression and Formal Writing

questions.question_text: Write a short formal application to your school librarian requesting them to issue a duplicate library card because you lost your original one. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Respected Librarian, I am writing to inform you that I have accidentally lost my original school library card on the way home yesterday. I have searched everywhere but cannot find it. I kindly request you to please issue me a duplicate library card. I am ready to pay the fine. Thank you.

questions.question_text: Describe a magical journey to the mountains using at least three adjectives of comparison (e.g., taller, biggest) and past tense verbs. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Yesterday, we traveled to the highest mountain peak in the region. The snowy path was steeper than I expected, but the view was the most beautiful sight ever. We climbed across the coldest glaciers and saw a deep valley below us. We felt happier than ever before reaching the summit.
